_about: Thomas Doolittle (1630?-1707), ejected minister of St Alphage, London Wall, and Baxter's pupil: A Treatise concerning the Lord's Supper, with three dialogues, second edition (London, 1668); Love to Christ Necessary to Escape the Curse at his Coming (London, 1693); and The Saints Mansions in Heaven, the funeral sermon for Elizabeth Brookes (London, 1698). Early English Books Online scans of first or early printings; the OCR prints the long s ('ſ') and old type, so expect errors. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
